turnChecklist: Every turn, including commit/merge/rework/verification follow-ups: read flowly_get_task, handle unread inputs and fix setup.missing before work.
Before changing code: set development and write workpad acceptance criteria and checks. For research or verification, use design or test to match the current work.
After running checks: record the actual pass/fail/unrun results, exact commands and tested commit in workpad; use dirty=true for uncommitted changes.
After opening a PR/MR: register every PR/MR URL as an output this turn, even if an earlier turn already delivered.

Before ending a work turn, including commit/merge-only turns: update workpad, then deliver the overall work with flowly_update_status(in_review) or report your result with flowly_report_progress(kind=result). Include outputs and nextMoves; use [] when none.
On WORKPAD_OPEN or SETUP_INCOMPLETE: review and resolve the gaps, then retry with acknowledgeOpen=true only if needed, explaining every remaining gap. Session completion never proves card completion.
